items.text:
Very excited to see how this game winds up. Very playable in its current state but shows obvious signs of being in early access( actual early access, not "early access")  the aesthetic of the game is really something that grips me, and it usually takes me a lot to get this into a game off the rip. If you like any of these you will enjoy this game probably: Barotrauma, SS13, Space engineers, Hardspace Shipbreaker, Rimworld. You get the point. It's just one of "those" games.

If I can make a few recommendations( and I'm sure this is already planned, but) I would suggest expanding on the law system, making it more of a bad decision to get caught doing something illegal, and have more consequences for it. Because right now killing people and just taking their stuff feels like a cheat code compared to actually finding scrap. Also the way you interact with NPCs is kinda confusing. I can't really tell what is actually happening when I "talk" to people. Feels kinda like the oblivion social wheel lol.
items.text_zh:
非常期待看到这款游戏最终会变成什么样。在目前的状态下已经非常可玩了，但明显显示出处于抢先体验阶段的迹象（真正的抢先体验，而不是“抢先体验”）。这款游戏的美学风格真的很吸引我，而通常我要对一款游戏一见钟情需要很多条件。如果你喜欢以下任何一款游戏，你可能会喜欢这款游戏：Barotrauma、SS13、Space engineers、Hardspace Shipbreaker、Rimworld。你懂我的意思。它就是那种“那种”游戏之一。

如果我可以提几个建议（我相信这已经在计划中了，但是）我建议扩展法律系统，让被抓到做违法的事更像是一个糟糕的决定，并为此承担更多后果。因为现在杀人然后直接拿走他们的东西，相比真正去找废料，感觉就像开了作弊码。另外，你和NPC互动的方式有点令人困惑。当我“和”人“交谈”时，我真的说不清到底发生了什么。感觉有点像《湮灭》里的社交轮盘，哈哈。

observations.description: 与NPC交谈时不清楚发生了什么
